item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
President Trump has waived several Russia sanctions, prompting Zelenskyy to accuse him of rewarding Putin while seeking European support. Russian forces have launched overnight drone attacks on civilian energy facilities across Ukraine, killing civilians and cutting power for over a million people. Ukrainian forces are advancing, pushing Russian troops back with Starlink communications playing a key role, even as Zelenskyy says Starlink speed limits are a planned operation. Russia is expanding its drone war with a new launch megabase. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
